ayurveda.title: Ayurvedic consultation
ayurveda.intro: This centre offers guidance and support in the following areas, based on individual consultation with the Vaidya.
ayurveda.notice: Ayurvedic medicines and remedies may be recommended after consultation with the Vaidya, depending on individual requirements. Please consult the Vaidya before taking any medicine or remedy.

disclaimer: This service is not for medical emergencies. No medical advice is provided online through this website.

about.title: About Us
about.mission: Arham Arogyam is a community initiative offering accessible Ayurvedic consultation to everyone in Bapu Nagar and the surrounding areas of Jaipur.
about.vaidyaBody: Vaidya Rahul Jain meets patients from the community at this centre every Tuesday evening for consultation.
about.accessBody: Many people in the community find it hard to access regular health consultation. This centre exists to make that consultation simple, unhurried, and open to anyone who walks in.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This notice explains what personal information Arham Arogyam collects when you book an appointment, why it is collected, how long it is kept, and how you can request its deletion. This policy is written to align with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act).
privacy.collectedBody: When you book an appointment, we collect your name, mobile number, age, gender, and reason for visit.
privacy.purposeBody: This information is used only to schedule and manage your consultation at the centre. It is not used for any other purpose.
privacy.retentionBody: Your appointment information is retained for 24 months from the date of your visit, after which it is deleted.
privacy.consentBody: You give your consent explicitly at the time of booking by actively choosing the consent option yourself. It is never selected for you in advance.
privacy.deletionBody: You can request deletion of your information by contacting the clinic directly.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: These terms explain how this website may be used. By using this website to view information or book an appointment, you agree to them.
terms.disclaimerBody: This website is not for medical emergencies. If you have a medical emergency, please go to the nearest hospital immediately. No medical advice is provided online through this website. Please always consult the Vaidya in person before taking any medicine or remedy.
terms.usageBody: This website helps you view information about the centre and book a consultation slot. Please provide accurate information when booking, as it is used only to manage your appointment.
terms.changesBody: These terms may be updated from time to time. Continuing to use this website after a change means you accept the updated terms.
